title: nan
key_contribution: Presents NaviLoc, a training-free trajectory-level visual localization method fusing image matching and VIO for GNSS-denied UAV navigation, achieving 19.5 m mean localization error with embedded deployment.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
